# planetscale_neki_router_parameters (Data Source)

Returns configurable parameters and their current values for a Neki router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_router_parameters" "my_nekirouterparameters" {
  branch       = "...my_branch..."
  database     = "...my_database..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
  router       = "...my_router..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `organization` (String)
- `router` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returns configurable parameters for the router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
